title: Selenium engineered nanomaterials enhance soil nitrogen retention and transformation through rhizosphere microbial interactions and hormone modulations
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN01209K, Paper
Shibo Liu, Chunli Lei, Bingxu Cheng, Xiaoxiao Zhang, Junyi Zhang, Chuanxi Wang, Zhenyu Wang
This study reveals that foliar application of Se ENMs significantly enhances nitrogen retention in paddy soils by modulating the metabolic pathways of rice roots and restructuring the soil microbial community, promoting agricultural sustainability.
